_what: The account's one door as this page reaches it (account-door.ts): the MCP route on this page's own origin and its one tool. An address of the door's own form, `form`, is one call of that tool; any other address was a retired Worker's route and is answered as no owner (api.ts failure_code no-owner). `most_ms` is the longest one call waits for the door's whole answer before it is given up as slow (api.ts failure words `slow`), so a screen whose computer does not answer says so with Try again instead of loading forever.
